title: Student Transportation Services Timetable: Annual Applications, Routing, Re-evaluation and Service Start
content:
The dates and day counts of Student Transportation Services for applications, routing and changes in a rider's situation. One timetable applies to all seven transportation types (Courtesy Rider Permit (Semester), Courtesy Rider Permit (Annual), Regular Route Eligibility, Hazardous Route Eligibility, Choice Program Hub Shuttle, McKinney-Vento School-of-Origin Transportation and Special Education Transportation); the only figure that differs is the continuation of school-of-origin service after housing.

| Item | Figure for every transportation type |
|---|---|
| A new application is needed every school year | yes |
| Date by which an application must be received to be routed for the first day of school | July 15 (07-15) |
| Calendar days after a late application within which a route is assigned | 10 |
| Calendar days after a reported address change within which eligibility is re-evaluated | 5 |
| Calendar days service continues after eligibility is lost through an address change (the re-evaluation date is day 0) | 10 |
| When service begins after approval | the first day of school, or the route assignment date |

| Transportation type | School-of-origin service continues to the end of the school year after the family obtains permanent housing |
|---|---|
| McKinney-Vento School-of-Origin Transportation | yes |
| every other type | no |

## Worked dates (hypothetical)

- An application received on July 15 is on time for the first day of school; one received on July 16 is late and is given a route within 10 calendar days of its receipt.
- An address change is reported on a Tuesday; eligibility is re-evaluated within 5 calendar days. If the re-evaluation, dated a Friday, finds the new address no longer qualifies, that Friday is day 0 and service continues through the 10th calendar day after it.
